annotations.text:
Main — the leading direction.
Dark hero, the install commands on a card straddling the fold so they read as the page's first object. Ripples from the mark carry the brand.

MainDark is the same page at the dark end of prefers-color-scheme; Mobile is Main at 390.

Two alternates, varying hero / commands / key panel.

B — light split hero with the mark at size, install as three numbered steps that each say why.
C — one dark deck, terminal-forward, hairline rules, key panel paired with its caveat.
